dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: A hundred and thirty-six... Alright, fourteen more times, and we'll take a break!

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Hehe, training, of course! Only through constant exercise of the body and soul can I defend this city and destroy the detestable barbarian invaders.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: And at the same time, prove myself to the Sebastos as worthy of ascension!

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: See you. Careful out there, now!

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: That's right. Those who wish to ascend must either possess extraordinary musical talent, or have proven themselves through equally outstanding achievements and loyalty.

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: I've not demonstrated much musicality in my life, so I can only secure ascension through ceaseless training!

dialogues.speaker: Venier
dialogues.text: Haha, thank you for the encouragement, friend! I, too, wish for the Sebastos to choose you to ascend to immortal form!
